title: The Cursed Spore
summary: Help the Prophets of Gukta weaken the Cursed Spore while your raid drives its health down.
overview: Help the Prophets of Gukta weaken the Cursed Spore while your raid drives its health down.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: The Spore begins immune to slow. At 90% health, the prophets remove that immunity, creating an opportunity to slow its attacks.
At 75%, 50% and 25% health, its elemental and magical resistances fall in stages. Casters should expect greater resistance early in the fight.
Regaining health can restore earlier resistance stages. Leaving combat restores the initial resistances and slow immunity.
Its defeat opens the route toward Gragna and the final Keeper encounter.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
